notes: Fiction removed: Pirates of the Caribbean, One Piece, Black Sails, Captain Pugwash, The Princess Bride and King Kong items. Kept public-domain fiction: Peter Pan (Captain Hook, Smee, Neverland), Treasure Island (Long John Silver, Captain Flint, Hispaniola, Walrus), Captain Blood (1922), The Pirates of Penzance, and myth/folklore (Flying Dutchman, Odyssey, Argo, Sinbad, King Arthur). 'hook' was dropped from pirates and 'Jolly Roger' (Hook's ship) from pirate ships because pirates must not repeat its sub-themes' members; Jolly Roger stays in pirates as the flag. 'Star Wars program' (cold war) kept: it is the real nickname of SDI, not the film. Hokulea is now "Hōkūle'a" with an ASCII apostrophe standing in for the Hawaiian okina; Maori canoe names use macrons (Tākitimu, Mātaatua, Kurahaupō, Taputapuātea), but kumara, Hawaii and Aotearoa stay plain. Names that English reference works write without diacritics stay plain: Vo Nguyen Giap, Dien Bien Phu, Bao Dai, Liliuokalani, Ain Jalut. 'Pourquoi-Pas' stays without its '?' because '?' is not an allowed character. St. Albans, St. Mihiel and V-E Day/V-J Day use the American form, with the British form in uk. Separate themes: the parents exploration and polar exploration are not in this batch. I assumed they are playable. 'famous battles' is separate from 'wars and battles' because bare place names (Trenton, Sedan) do not read as war; its child battle themes are fine under it. The parent 'famous people' has sub-themes outside this batch (us presidents, inventors, reformers, famous women in history), so I could not check it for overlap with them.
